svg.title: Block (suspend) a reported user | US-17 + US-18

g.text: Block (suspend) a reported user | US-17 + US-18
From report: suspend reported student + reason
[caller is not ADMIN, or userId == caller (self-suspension)]
SELECT account by userId FOR UPDATE
[account not found or not a STUDENT]
[reason shorter than 5 chars or unknown status]
Any protected request with old access token
Login now returns 403 (suspended); suspended students are excluded from matches.
The report itself is resolved separately (02).
